notes: Unmerge accounts: if two banks were combined by mistake, open the account and tap "Split back out" to separate them again
Kotak accounts (like Kotak811) are read correctly and kept separate from HDFC and other banks
Each account shows under the right bank, read from the SMS sender and sign-off, not a payee or the other person's bank
GPay, PhonePe and BHIM payments sit under your real bank instead of a separate app account
Balance replies from the bank update that account, and balances carry forward through newer spends
